sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Cosmetics and Personal Care Products

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (US-derived) with customary law overlay
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (Title II, 1986, as amended) — investor protection and economic relations provisions
No bilateral investment treaty, double taxation avoidance agreement, or free trade agreement with foreign countries currently in force

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990 (Title 51, Revised Statutes and Regulations of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, as amended) (BCA); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2019 (as amended) and AML/CFT Regulations 2021; Registrar of Corporations Practice Directions on Beneficial Ownership and Customer Due Diligence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport of each natural person UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of the UBO's country of origin / Notary Public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (bank statement or utility bill, not older than 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider / licensed bank in the UBO's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming business relationship and source of introduction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Institution of the UBO's principal bank

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (for corporate UBOs above 25% ownership)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar of the corporate owner's incorporation jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of constitutional documents and registry extract of the corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate UBO's registered agent / company registry

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO declaration and ultimate beneficial owner attestation form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: RMI registered agent / licensed corporate services provider

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory and continuous screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, the US OFAC SDN (Specially Designated Nationals) and SSI (Sectoral Sanctions Identifications) lists, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and the Republic of the Marshall Islands domestic designated persons and entities list maintained by the RMI AML/CFT Supervisory Authority. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and their family members or close associates must be subjected to enhanced due diligence (EDD), including documented source-of-funds and source-of-wealth analysis, senior-level on-boarding approval, and increased periodic transaction monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Corporate Registry – Name Reservation and Clearance Portal (administered by the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be submitted in English using Latin-script characters only (20-character OCR-compatible transliteration required for any intended foreign-script trade name). The name must end in a corporate designator mandatory under Section 18 of the Business Corporations Act: 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', 'Company', 'Société Anonyme', or abbreviation thereof. No diacritical, non-Roman, or non-English script is permitted in the registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within five business days of name rejection, the applicant may request an administrative reconsideration from the Registrar of Corporations, accompanied by evidence of prior ministerial approval where applicable or a revised alternate name. Concurrently, the applicant may rely on a fresh name reservation filing for up to two alternate names. If the Registrar maintains rejection after reconsideration, an administrative appeal may be filed with the RMI Administrative Review Board within 30 days, followed by judicial review in the RMI High Court within 60 days from the date of the final administrative decision. The appeal must include the original name rejection notice, a legal argument demonstrating compliance with Section 18 of the BCA, and, where sensitive tokens are used, the specific ministerial authorization letter.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is permissible solely as the physical registered agent's address maintained in Majuro for service of process, but it does not constitute economic substance that would convert the non-resident exempt entity into a tax resident. For an ISIC 4791 online cosmetics retailer, a virtual office arrangement is acceptable at the pre-incorporation and license-filing level; there is no statutory requirement to maintain inventory, employees, or premises in the Marshall Islands, but the registered agent must maintain a physical office open during business hours and must make corporate records available for inspection.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated 0–3% annual risk of unannounced on-site inspection for a standard-risk, non-resident e-commerce entity. Unannounced inspections may be conducted by the Registrar of Corporations or law enforcement under Sections 47 and 48 of the BCA and the AML/CFT Act, primarily to verify the registered office address, registered agent continuity, and availability of UBO records. For an online beauty retail entity with no physical footprint, the inspection risk is materially lower than for financial or licensed activities.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee (minimum paid-up capital §18 BCA)
Registered agent and registered office service — first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for non-resident wash-through entities

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per AML/CFT obligations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille/consular legalization bundle for UBO and address documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public / apostille authority / consular office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory schedule of originating notary + apostille issuance fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank reference letter procurement for payment rails (Shopify Payments, PayPal)
Legal consultation and pre-incorporation opinion on name clearance and UBO compliance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark / negotiated fixed fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent consent and BCA Section 35 physical address verification

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (BCA), Title 27 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, 27 MIRC § 1 et seq., as amended, including § 5 (Execution of Articles), § 6 (Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation), and § 108 (Corporate Name Requirements); patterned upon the Delaware General Corporation Law.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce and Investment, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro Atoll; filings are lodged through licensed RMI registered agents.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form 1 under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act. The Corporation may fully commence business with zero paid-in capital; the Board of Directors determines the consideration received for shares (cash, property, or services), and any funds paid in may be deposited in any commercial bank of the Board's choosing. No statutory escrow, trust account, or capital impoundment is mandated for an exempt non-resident Business Corporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation's authorized share subscription is approved and the Secretary is directed to issue 1,000 shares of common stock, $1.00 par value, to the incorporator upon payment of $1,000.00; and RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation shall be fixed at the office of its licensed registered agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the registered agent is authorized to accept service of process on the Corporation's behalf; and RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed as officers of the Corporation to serve at the pleasure of the Board: [Name], President; [Name], Secretary; [Name], Treasurer; and the President is authorized to execute all banking, payment-rail and e-commerce agreements necessary for the Corporation's online cosmetics retail business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce and Investment, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; request submitted by a licensed RMI registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a Name Reservation Request listing three ranked name choices. The Registrar conducts an exact-match and confusingly-similar search against the registered-name index. The proposed name must include a corporate identifier such as 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or an accepted abbreviation. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 30 days pending the filing of the Articles of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Certificate of good standing of any foreign parent entity, if applicable
Cover letter from the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or for violating 27 MIRC § 108, file an amended reservation containing a distinctive differentiating element; no additional fee is assessed if corrected and refiled within 30 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarized Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public registered in the Republic of the Marshall Islands or consular notarization at an RMI Embassy or Consulate; preparer is a licensed RMI attorney or registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation stating the corporate name, registered office street address in Majuro, resident registered agent name and address, lawful purpose clause (including e-commerce retail distribution of cosmetics and personal care products), authorized capital structure (e.g. 1,000 shares of common stock, $1.00 par value), and the names and addresses of the initial directors. Each incorporator and initial director executes the Articles; all signature pages are notarized or acknowledged in accordance with 27 MIRC § 5(b).
required_dossiers: Notarization or acknowledgment page for each signatory
Passport copies of incorporators and initial directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization is defective, cure by re-execution before a qualified notary public; if the proposed registered agent declines consent, substitute another licensed RMI agent and append the replacement consent before submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Articles of Incorporation and Payment of State Filing Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; paper filing at the Registry or submission through the Registrar-approved electronic portal maintained by the licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the original notarized Articles of Incorporation together with the Registered Agent Consent and remittance of the USD 275 state incorporation fee. The Registrar examines the instrument for statutory compliance; upon acceptance, the Registrar affixes the filing endorsement and date and causes the Certificate of Incorporation to be issued.
required_dossiers: Incorporation fee payment confirmation (wire transfer or licensed agent remittance)
Transmittal letter from the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency or query notice, respond within the cure period, ordinarily 20 business days, by filing the corrected pages or a supplemental statement; if the instrument is rejected, refile a corrected set without prejudice to the original name reservation date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Assembly of Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations for the Certificate of Incorporation; licensed RMI registered agent for corporate records custody.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation, which evidences the legal existence of the Corporation under 27 MIRC § 6. The registered agent then assembles the corporate records book containing the Certificate of Incorporation, draft bylaws, minute book, share certificate ledger, and corporate seal. Certified copies of the Certificate are obtained for opening the corporate bank account and for onboarding Shopify Payments and PayPal as payment rails.
required_dossiers: Request for certified copies, if needed for bank or payment-provider due diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If certified copies are delayed, request expedited certification from the Registry; if the Certificate contains a clerical discrepancy (e.g. name spelling), file a Certificate of Correction under 27 MIRC § 116.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting and Adoption of Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial directors of the Corporation acting by unanimous written consent in lieu of an organizational meeting.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The initial directors execute a Unanimous Written Consent adopting the Bylaws, which govern the board of directors (minimum one director), officers, share transfer restrictions, indemnification under 27 MIRC § 44, and meeting procedures including virtual or teleconference meetings. The executed consent and bylaws are filed in the corporate records book, and director signatures are witnessed.
required_dossiers: Draft Bylaws of the Business Corporation
Unanimous Written Consent in Lieu of Organizational Meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any director refuses to sign or the consent is incomplete, convene a physical or virtual organizational meeting upon proper notice and record the adjourned minutes reflecting the adoption of the bylaws.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution – Share Subscription, Registered Office and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Business Corporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Board adopts the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution which (i) approves the subscription and issuance of 1,000 shares of common stock, $1.00 par value, for aggregate consideration of $1,000.00 paid into the Corporation's bank account; (ii) confirms the registered office at the registered agent's office in Majuro; and (iii) appoints the President, Secretary and Treasurer. The resolution is entered into the minute book and signed by all directors.
required_dossiers: Pro-Forma First Board Resolution (as drafted in the docket)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a payment provider or bank challenges capitalization during AML/KYC review, supplement the file with the share ledger and bank statement evidencing paid-in capital; officers may be re-appointed by a subsequent unanimous written consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Agent Retention, Annual Compliance and Non-Resident Tax Exemption Status
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed RMI Registered Agent; Office of the Registrar of Corporations; Tax Division of the Ministry of Finance for the non-resident exemption determination.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize the Registered Agency Agreement for the continuing maintenance of the registered office and registered agent in Majuro. File the initial Standard Annual Corporation Report and pay the annual franchise fee of USD 275. Because the Corporation is a non-resident entity deriving no income from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands, it qualifies for the Tax-Exempt Zone classification and is not assessable to RMI income tax; no business license fee is levied on offshore e-commerce activity. The corporate seal, share ledger, resolutions and minutes remain available for inspection by the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Declaration of non-resident status for tax exemption purposes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual report is rejected, correct and refile within the extended filing period; if the Registrar or Tax Division makes an inadvertent 'doing business in the RMI' determination, file an exemption application with the Tax Division and, if necessary, seek an abatement before the Registrar.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — the Corporation is a non-resident virtual retailer with no industrial, manufacturing, or physical establishment in the Republic of the Marshall Islands; no industrial licensing board has jurisdiction over offshore e-commerce distribution.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no manufacturing, warehousing, or physical retail operating permit is required under Marshall Islands law for a non-resident online retailer of cosmetics. The general RMI business license is not triggered because all sales are concluded outside RMI territory and no local place of business exists.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA), established under the Environmental Protection Act 2008
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 3: No EIA required. The activity consists solely of online order processing, digital marketing, and courier-based export distribution; there is no land alteration, construction, manufacturing, or discharge source located within RMI territory.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — zero wastewater discharge, zero Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) emissions, and no regulated solid or hazardous waste streams are generated within the Republic of the Marshall Islands; therefore no compliance thresholds are imposed by the RMI EPA on this virtual retail operation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — the Corporation maintains no physical premises, employees, or public-access facility in the Marshall Islands; fire safety certification, structural load inspection, and workplace occupational clearance are waived for a remotely administered, non-resident virtual operation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance, Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro, MH 96960). No centralized e-filing portal exists; BPT registration and returns are processed physically at the Revenue and Taxation Division, P.O. Box 31, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Business Corporation (BC) under the Business Corporations Act with the Registrar of Corporations (Office of the Attorney General), obtaining a Charter Number (not a TIN). Step 2: If the BC derives gross revenue sourced from business conducted in RMI, file Form BPT-1 with the Revenue and Taxation Division promptly upon commencement of business and obtain the BPT/TIN number; non-citizen-owned entities operating in RMI must also obtain a Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) from the Ministry of Commerce, which is a licensing requirement rather than a tax registration. Step 3: If the BC derives no RMI-source revenue (offshore / non-resident profile), no BPT registration, TIN, or FIBL is required; the standard identity document is the Certificate of Good Standing issued by the Registrar of Corporations. Step 4: For physical goods crossing the RMI border, register for a customs importer/exporter code with the RMI Customs and Ports Authority and file entries using the Charter Number. For the non-resident beauty DTC model (Shopify Payments/PayPal, no RMI office, employees, or inventory), no TIN procurement is statutorily required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable – RMI imposes no corporate income tax and provides no check-the-box, CFE, LLC pass-through, or hybrid mismatch elections. The only available administrative election is the filing of a declaration of non-residence / non-business activity confirming zero RMI-source gross revenue, which evidences the default Tax_Exempt_Zone (offshore) classification; should RMI-source revenue later arise, registration for Business Privilege Tax becomes mandatory.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax is imposed by RMI. Analogous levies are: (i) Business Privilege Tax (BPT), a gross-receipts tax at the standard 3% rate (retail/services) applied only to RMI-source gross revenue where business is conducted in RMI; (ii) Import Duty under the Customs Tariff Act on physical goods entering RMI (cosmetics/personal-care products under HS 3304 per the published RMI tariff schedule); and (iii) Social Security contributions at the statutory combined employer/employee rates, only where RMI-resident employees are engaged. A non-resident BC selling DTC cosmetics to non-RMI customers has no RMI indirect-tax nexus.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold applies in USD. BPT registration is mandatory upon the first dollar of RMI-source gross revenue; no VAT registration threshold exists because no VAT is imposed. Customs registration applies per import/export entry where goods cross the RMI border.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. RMI does not mandate e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API transmission, or digital stamping for sales invoices. The only automated fiscal interface is the electronic customs declaration system (ASYCUDA World) operated by the RMI Customs and Ports Authority for border transactions; no transaction-level fiscal API applies to BPT or retail sales.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is conceptually inapplicable because RMI has no VAT/GST and therefore no export VAT refund mechanism. The functional equivalent is the BPT exclusion: revenue from sales by a non-resident BC to customers outside RMI, with delivery outside RMI and no RMI office, employees, or inventory, is entirely outside the BPT base and requires no refund claim. In a pure drop-ship model (goods shipped from US/EU/APAC fulfillment centers directly to non-RMI customers), no RMI customs transaction occurs. Goods physically exported from RMI territory are excluded from BPT gross revenue when the export is documented under the Customs Act and not attributable to an RMI permanent establishment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (RMI Customs and Ports Authority, filed via ASYCUDA World)
Commercial Invoice / Packing List stating ISIC 4791 online-retail descriptor, HS 3304 classification, and full cosmetic ingredient disclosure
Bill of Lading or Master Air Waybill consigned to the overseas customer
Certificate of Origin (issued by the RMI Chamber of Commerce where tariff preference is claimed)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT credit advice evidencing receipt of export proceeds (no RMI FX controls; retained as banking best-practice substantiation, not a statutory mandate)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No export VAT clawback exists because RMI has no VAT system. Audit risk attaches to BPT characterization: if the Revenue and Taxation Division recharacterizes the BC as having RMI-source gross revenue, BPT at the standard 3% rate is assessed de novo, plus monthly statutory interest and penalties up to 25% of the underpayment, with retroactive registration. False customs export declarations attract Customs Act penalties including forfeiture of goods, fines, and suspension of the customs code. For the Shopify/PayPal DTC model with no RMI nexus, the material exposure is documentary proof of non-RMI delivery (IP geolocation, shipment tracking, payment-rail records), which should be retained for a minimum of 7 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (no domestic central bank; U.S. dollar is legal tender)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility in both current and capital accounts is in effect because the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) has no domestic currency; the U.S. dollar is lawful money. There are no exchange-control restrictions on capital movements to or from the RMI, no profit remittance taxes or delays for non-resident business corporations, and no requirement for central bank approval on cross-border transfers. The only compliance conditionals are bank-level AML/CFT screening, FIU reporting thresholds, and documentary support from the client.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable – the RMI imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no deadline for repatriation. Exporters may retain 100% of proceeds in any USD-denominated account, or in any other currency subject to normal bank risk policies, and may use them directly for operations or reinvestment.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for use as a primary treasury bank. Under the RMI Banking Act and Financial Institutions Act, any institution undertaking deposit-taking business in or from the RMI must be licensed locally; offshore digital EMIs such as Wise or Revolut are not licensed in the RMI and cannot legally hold deposits for RMI-incorporated entities. They may serve only as third-party payment facilitators for e-commerce merchant settlement (e.g., Shopify Payments, PayPal) but are not acceptable for capital injection escrow, statutory audits, or cross-border corporate bank account verification.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For Bank of Marshall Islands, at least one director or authorized signatory must appear physically at the branch in Majuro for account opening and to execute the bank's account mandate; remote opening is generally not permitted. Bank of Guam may permit remote opening for non-resident entities, provided that: (i) certified true copies of corporate documents are apostilled and mailed to the branch; (ii) each director's identity is verified via high-quality notarized copies; and (iii) a mandatory audio-video KYC interview is conducted with a bank officer. In practice, RMI banks are highly risk-averse for non-face-to-face clients, so a nominated director with physical presence in Majuro or a long-standing introduction from a registered agent is recommended to avoid onboarding delays.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity – non-resident business corporation with no local substance and nominee directors/shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a complete legal ownership and ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) chart, passports and proof of residential address for each natural person UBO, certificate of good standing from the RMI Registrar, registered agent letter, articles of incorporation and bylaws, and a signed declaration of source of wealth and source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk payment-receiving channels – large volumes of consumer card transactions through Shopify Payments and PayPal without a demonstrated merchant track record.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit merchant gateway agreements, 12 months of settlement reports, bank statements in the entity's name, product catalog, website URLs, evidence of order/refund workflows, a PCI-DSS attestation from the payment processor, and a revenue forecast explaining the expected transaction volumes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border money movement – frequent inbound transfers from low-tax or tax-haven jurisdictions associated with private clients.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide commercial rationale in the form of signed supplier contracts, customer agreements, invoicing and purchase orders, and an intercompany or shareholder resolution specifying the nature of each capital injection or loan. Include the remitter's bank confirmation of identity and source of funds, plus an independent audit of the company's books if requested by the bank's compliance unit.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injections and shareholder loans are routed as SWIFT MT103 or Fedwire USD transfers to the RMI bank account. The beneficiary account number must match the registered corporate name, and the remittance field (field 70) must clearly state either 'Equity injection – [Company Name]' or 'Shareholder loan – [Company Name]'. The bank will require a board resolution authorizing the account to receive such funds, completed RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) currency transaction reports for thresholds set under the MLTR Act, and supporting documentation for source of funds. Payments originating from an account that is not in the name of the beneficial owner will be returned or placed in a restricted account until a full originator KYC package is received.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier settlement from RMI is executed through: (i) SWIFT MT103 wire transfer for standard trade invoices below USD 250,000; (ii) Commercial documentary Letters of Credit (LC) for large or high-value raw material orders, routed through correspondent banks in the United States (e.g., via ABA routing through FRB-equivalent clearing); and (iii) purchase order-backed payments using remittance advice references (e.g., invoice numbers, LC number) to comply with bank monitoring. For recurring cosmetics inventory purchases, establishing a cross-border USD 'pool account' at the RMI bank's US correspondent (e.g., via Bank of Guam's US operations) can reduce clearing times by up to one business day.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla USD/EUR forward contracts (plain OTC forwards)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on non-convertible or offshore currencies such as USD/CNY and USD/KRW
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for conversion of dual-currency financing
FX options (put/call) for hedging USD revenue against foreign-currency supplier exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Annual Franchise Tax Return (Form AR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (filed through the licensed resident registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the last day of the calendar month immediately following the month of the incorporation anniversary (e.g., a March anniversary is due by 30 April each year).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing and late payment attract a monthly penalty of approximately USD 100 per month or fraction thereof. If the annual report remains unfiled and franchise tax unpaid after the Registrar's statutory delinquency notice period, the Registrar may administratively dissolve the corporation; reinstatement requires settlement of all unpaid government fees, penalties, and reinstatement charges.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Return (relevant activity assessment and tax-residence declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations / Economic Substance Compliance Office, Republic of the Marshall Islands (filed through the licensed resident registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed concurrently with the Annual Report by the last day of the month following the month of incorporation anniversary; a supplemental declaration is required within 30 days of commencing or ceasing a relevant activity or of any change in claimed tax residence.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or materially false declarations attract civil penalties under the RMI Economic Substance Regulations (up to USD 10,000 per violation), may trigger exchange of information with the jurisdiction of the ultimate beneficial owner's tax residence, and repeated non-compliance may lead to suspension or administrative dissolution of the corporation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) and AML/KYC Confirmation to the Licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed resident registered agent of the corporation; the non-public beneficial ownership register is maintained at the RMI registered office and is produced to the Registrar of Corporations or the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit only upon lawful demand.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the Annual Report renewal (last day of the month following the incorporation anniversary month); an updated confirmation is additionally required within 14 days of any change in shareholding, directorship, or ultimate beneficial ownership.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or confirm current UBO records may result in the registered agent declining further services, loss of good standing, suspension of corporate powers, and AML/CFT regulatory penalties; knowingly false UBO information may expose directors, officers, or beneficial owners to fines and criminal liability under RMI AML/CFT law.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a non-resident, non-listed Business Corporation. The RMI Business Corporations Act does not impose an independent statutory audit based on turnover, assets, revenue, or employee count. A compulsory audit arises only if required by the corporation's articles or bylaws, a shareholder resolution, a secured creditor instrument, or an order of the RMI Registrar of Corporations.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS is the recognized reference accounting framework in the Republic of the Marshall Islands; however, non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporations are not required to file financial statements with the Registrar and commonly maintain books under IFRS or US GAAP in alignment with the ultimate parent's reporting framework.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The RMI maintains a non-public beneficial ownership register. The licensed resident agent must obtain, verify, and hold current UBO data. The company must provide an annual written confirmation of its registered members, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners, together with any share transfer or control change, concurrently with the Annual Report. The agent discloses the register only to the Registrar of Corporations or the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit upon lawful request.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (share ledger and transfer records)
Register of Directors and Officers (with residential addresses)
Minute Book (board and shareholder meetings and unanimous written consents)
Beneficial Ownership Register (maintained by the licensed resident agent at the RMI registered office)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 750 – USD 2,000 per annum (licensed RMI registered agent and registered office address, including standard Annual Report coordination)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required for a non-resident Business Corporation; a voluntary IFRS audit typically ranges from USD 3,000 – USD 8,000, and an IFRS compilation or review engagement typically ranges from USD 1,500 – USD 3,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident Business Corporations operate under a statutory zero-rate tax regime: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no dividend/capital gains tax, no gross receipts tax, and no value-added tax. The only periodic state cost is the annual Marshall Islands government registration fee payable through the licensed registered agent; no income tax holiday application or tax ruling is required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No income tax return form is prescribed for a non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporation. Compliance is effected through the annual corporate registry statement filed by the licensed registered agent using the RMI Registrar's online Agent Portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual registry statement and government registration fee must be submitted no later than the anniversary of incorporation, or such earlier date as the registered agent's engagement letter requires, to maintain the corporation in good standing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact corporate name, registration number, and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the RMI Business Corporation name and certificate number. No local tax ID is required because no income tax return is filed for non-resident BCs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed registered agent's physical address in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporations must maintain a registered agent and a registered office in Majuro; the agent's street address is sufficient and no local operating office is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, residential addresses, and nationalities of all directors and officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No local residency or directorship requirement exists. Beneficial ownership must be disclosed to the registered agent and a register of directors maintained at the agent's office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Registry Item 4 — Share Capital and Treasury
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized capital, issued shares, and paid-up consideration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Minimum capital is not required. Quote figures in USD and confirm that no securities were offered to the public in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Concise statement of the actual commercial activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'online retail distribution of cosmetics and personal care products (ISIC 4791)' and confirm all sales, contracting, and decision-making occur outside the Marshall Islands with no RMI situs of management.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to submit the annual registry statement and pay the government fee triggers a late-payment surcharge, accruing administrative penalties per the Registrar's fee schedule, and eventual administrative dissolution or strike-off of the corporate name. A struck-off corporation loses legal capacity in RMI, and directors or officers who continue to act in its name become personally liable for debts and obligations incurred during the period of dissolution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. The Marshall Islands has not entered into comprehensive double taxation conventions; therefore no reduced-rate treaty relief or domestic Tax Residency Certificate process is available. Distributions paid by a non-resident Marshall Islands BC to foreign shareholders are not subject to RMI withholding; the shareholder's residence country determines the tax treatment, and a foreign-residence tax certificate may be required by that country to claim foreign tax credits or treaty benefits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding is 0% on interest and 0% on royalties paid to non-residents by a non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporation. Treaty rates are not available because the RMI has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory RMI transfer pricing documentation threshold exists in USD or other currency. However, foreign parent jurisdictions may impose OECD/BEPS-aligned Master File, Local File, and Country-by-Country reporting obligations once group revenue and cross-border intercompany transactions exceed that foreign threshold (e.g., EUR 750 million for CbCR).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) apply to entities carrying out 'relevant activities', including holding, headquarters, finance/leasing, distribution and service centers, and IP exploitation, from the RMI. A non-resident online cosmetics retailer with only a registered agent and no RMI office, employees, management, or physical assets must document that no relevant activity is undertaken in RMI and, where applicable, that the entity is managed and controlled in the foreign beneficial-owner jurisdiction; failure to do so risks classification as a non-compliant shell company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Corporate Income Tax Evasion and Sham Non-Residency
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Marshall Islands non-resident BC to misattribute contracts, customer intangibles, e-commerce goodwill, or inventory while substantive management, warehouse logistics, and sales activities are performed in a high-tax jurisdiction without arm's-length compensation arrangements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign tax authorities may reallocate income under CFC rules, permanent establishment doctrines, substance-over-form anti-abuse rules, and general anti-avoidance provisions. The RMI Registrar may dissolve the BC for false annual filings or for failing to maintain an active registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers engaged in deliberate concealment can be denied the corporate veil and held jointly and severally liable for unpaid foreign taxes, interest, and penalties of the operating business. Criminal tax fraud proceedings may lead to extradition, travel bans, asset freezes, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a dormant RMI retail or holding entity without an RMI office, staff, payroll, or physical assets, and filing registry statements that falsely claim non-residence or fail to disclose the absence of RMI management and control.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines and penalties under RMI Economic Substance Regulations, compulsory strike-off, invalidation of the claimed exemption, and heightened regulatory review. Financial institutions may close bank and payment-processor accounts owing to correspondent-bank de-risking and EU/OECD listing concerns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly certify false economic-substance declarations commit a misrepresentation to the Registrar; they may be disqualified from serving as directors, personally fined, and criminally prosecuted where false documentation forms part of a broader money-laundering or sanctions scheme.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to identify and disclose natural-person beneficial owners, omitting beneficial-ownership records from the registered agent's AML file, or using layered payment structures through Shopify Payments and PayPal to obscure the source or destination of cosmetic retail proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Marshall Islands money-laundering legislation imposes civil monetary penalties and imprisonment of up to 25 years for knowing money laundering; the entity may be subject to asset freezes, enforced deregistration, and restrictions on maintaining a financial account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are individually prosecutable for inadequate AML controls, conspiracy to launder funds, or facilitating illicit payment processing. Arrest warrants may be accompanied by passport surrender, travel bans, and pre-trial detention.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misrepresentation to Registrar and Fraudulent Trading
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing false registry statements, maintaining fictitious directors, concealing shareholder changes, continuing to trade while insolvent, or using the RMI BC to perpetuate fraud on creditors or counterparties in the beauty retail supply chain.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act and general fraud law, the Registrar may strike the BC, impose civil fines, and apply to the High Court for judicial supervision, liquidation, or compulsory dissolution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: RMI courts may pierce the corporate veil where the BC is a mere facade, hold directors personally liable for wrongful trading and fraudulent preferences, and issue orders preventing directors from leaving the Marshall Islands when traceable proceeds remain abroad.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Local Business Activity and Foreign Investment Violation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Hiring local RMI employees, storing inventory in an RMI warehouse, operating a retail outlet in the RMI, or soliciting physical customers in the Marshall Islands while still claiming tax-exempt non-resident status without the required Foreign Investment Business License or domestic business authorization.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Carrying on business without the requisite RMI license subjects the BC to regulatory cease-and-desist orders, revocation of its exemption, import restrictions, monetary penalties, and possible strike-off for exceeding the lawful scope of a non-resident entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Foreign directors who authorize unauthorized local operations may be held personally liable for civil fines and unlicensed-business restitution, denied entry or renewal of work permits, and in cases of persistent regulatory violation, excluded from acting as directors of any RMI-registered entity.
